Well done! I knew you'd do it!\fI don't need to tell you anything\rmore! Why don't you see how quickly\fyou can clear this map? Ten days is\fa good benchmark, but if you're really\rgood, you could do it in five.\fWell, good luck!\fI'm counting on you!\f

So, we've got a naval battle on our\rhands here, eh?\fIf Nell hadn't taken out my air units,\rvictory would be much easier...\fBut they can't use most of their\rtroops, so that puts us on equal\ffooting. To battle!\f
It's your turn.\f
This was a very strategic point for\rOlaf to attack Orange Star.\fThanks to you, we managed to\rblock his assault! Thank you!\fKeep up the good work!\f
I never expected them to make it\rthis far...\fAugh!!! Just wait until next time!\f

I have a bad feeling about this.\fIt looks like Olaf...\rhas been waiting for us.\fIf we let him use his power,\rthere'll be trouble.\fLet's take him out all at once!\fI'm going to leave this one up\rto you! Good luck!\f
Ha ha ha! I've been waiting for you.\fNow I shall unleash my power!\fHeavens, hear my cry!\fBLIZZARD!!!\f

It's Olaf's CO Power!\fThis is what he's been waiting for...\fWe've been caught in his trap!\fEvery CO has his or her own special\rpower--a CO Power.\fWhen Olaf uses his CO Power, a huge\rsnow storm drops in. It's devastating!\fBut I can't use my CO Power right\rnow.\fI'm sorry.\fThere's one more thing...\fOlaf is very adept in the snow.\fIt's this power that caught\rBlue Moon's eye.\fSnow lowers the movement\rrange of all units.\f
This has turned into a rough battle.\fBut it should stop snowing after a\rfew days.\fJust be patient and try to\rhold out until then.\f

Huh?\fThe snow stopped!!!\fAugh! I don't have enough time to\rbuild up my power again...\fBut...I must have put fear into their\rhearts! Go, my soldiers!\fDon't give them time to regroup!\fDefeat them all!\f
You held out long enough!\fThe snow has stopped!\fYou'd better watch out, though...\rOlaf still has plenty of units.\fYou must regroup!\f

It's started raining!\fThis is a real blessing!\fRain slows movement a little bit.\fMore importantly, rain punishes Olaf.\fHe'll be brought to a virtual standstill!\fYou have to move now!\fTake him out in one swift blow!\f
What's this?\fIt's started raining???\fAugh!!!\fOur spirits will have to carry us!\f

Each CO has a unique special ability.\fIn Olaf's case, he works well\rin snow, but he's susceptible to rain.\fRegardless of that, you were\rgreat this time!\fIf you can win the next battle,\rthen I'll have taught you all I can.\fI think the next battle will be our\rlast one together.\fKeep up the good work!\f
Even my trap didn't work...\fIf... If I don't win soon, they'll get back\rall the land I went to the trouble of\fcapturing.\fAugh!!! Just wait until next time!\f
Olaf's power causes it to snow.\fWhen it snows, you lose your\reffectiveness.\fJust try to group up as much\ras you can.\fBetter luck next time.\f

What a terrible view! The surrounding\rarea is almost completely hidden.\fThis phenomenon is known\ras Fog of War.\fWhen it is present, units can only\rsee a limited distance.\fCheck each unit's vision range to\rascertain the distance it can see.\f

The other lit areas are around your\rHQ, your cities, and other positions.\fThey're lit to lead you to them.\fThe areas around neutral cities or\renemy positions aren't, though.\fThey stay dark until you draw\rclose to them.\f
Move it over here.\f
These cities looked the same\rwhen they were dark, didn't they?\fWhen checking a city's allegiance,\rI suggest approaching with caution.\f
Move it over here.\f
When you have a larger vision range,\rit's much easier to spot enemies.\f
Oh, yes. Did you notice that this\rarea here is still dark?\fThat's because you can't see into\rwoods unless you're adjacent to them.\f
By the way, reefs are the same. They\rremain dark until you're next to them.\f
Let's go back a moment.\f
There could actually be something\rin this forest.\fWhy don't you send\ra unit to scout it out?\f
You can move here or here to\rcheck the forest.\fMove it to one of those spaces.\f

Now, another thing on the subject\rof forests and reefs.\fThis time, the enemy was using the\rterrain to conceal its troops, right?\fWell, you can do the same thing! Using\rthe terrain to hide is a good strategy.\fOf course, you'll be spotted if the\renemy moves next to you, but...\fDid you get all that?\fI told you before, if you need intel,\ruse the cursor and the R Button.\fPress the R Button, then use the\r+ Control Pad to read the intel.\fThis is the way to check out different\rterrains, including woods and reefs.\f
I'm going to leave the rest of this\rbattle to you. Good luck!\f

Well done!\fYou've finally driven Olaf off!\f
Andy! Come here!\f
Nell! What is it?\f

This is where I'll teach you some new\rcommands and other useful tidbits.\fSome of it may overlap with other\rthings I've taught you, though.\fSo, if you'd like to skip this\rlesson, just reset the game.\fTo reset, press START, SELECT,\rand the A and B Buttons at once.\fI'm going to begin now, OK?\fI'll explain a few things we haven't\rtouched on yet.\fI hope you'll try them all out.\f
When you want to move it over here,\ryou just move the cursor in a straight\fline and press the A Button, right?\f
But right now there's an enemy here\rthat you can't see.\f
If you move in a straight line,\ryou'll run into it.\f
But pay attention to the red line that\rappears when you move the cursor.\fIt follows the cursor's path.\fDo you know what this means?\f
This actually shows your unit's\rmovement direction.\f
So, your unit follows this path\rwhen it moves.\f
If you move the line over\rthis way, you'll be fine.\f
Just move the cursor like this!\f

Uh-oh! You encountered an enemy...\fWhen a unit runs into an enemy,\rits turn automatically ends.\fThis, of course, can\rbe very dangerous.\fWhen you know an enemy is hiding\rnearby, avoid him with this technique.\f

Oh, unit data?\fThis gives you detailed information\rabout all of your units in the field.\fBut I've already told you that,\rhaven't I?\fYou can change what information\ryou see by moving the cursor.\fOh! One more thing...\fHave you ever wanted information\rabout the terrain the unit is on?\fJust press the R Button once more\rto view it! Try it yourself.\f

The L Button, huh?\fThe L Button moves the cursor to\runits you haven't moved yet.\fThe Field Training maps have been\rsmall, so you haven't really needed it.\fOf course, the War Room and\rCampaign maps can be much larger...\fYou'll probably want to spread\ryour units out all over the map.\fThat's when it's quicker to use the\rL Button than to move the cursor.\fGive it a try!\f

Terrain data...\fThis is where you get detailed\rinformation about the terrain.\fYou can check things like terrain\rcover and city income.\fMovement Cost shows a unit's\rmovement over the selected terrain.\fIt's easiest to view when it's\rcombined with unit data.\fOh, I almost forgot!\fYou can switch between terrain\rdetails and movement cost easily...\fJust press up and down\ron the + Control Pad.\f
Look at this...\fDo you see Type, HP, Gas, and\rRds (Rounds) all lined up here?\f
Right now, the cursor is on Type.\fYou can press left and right on the\r+ Control Pad to choose a menu!\fTry it out.\f

Ah, yes, the deployment menu.\fYour bases are where all of your\rland units have been deployed.\fThe number next to each unit is the\rcost of deploying that unit.\fIf it costs less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fAlso, because there are so many land\runits, they might not fit on one page.\fUse the + Control Pad to scroll to\rthe very bottom of the page.\fThat's right. You can use the units\rone day after you deploy them.\fJust remember that the units wait\rthe first day you deploy them.\fYou'll probably wonder what units\ryou should produce first. Which one\fwas the easiest to use in your\fField Training? Focus on those\rfirst, then slowly deploy others.\f
Oh. Then choose something\relse.\f

OK--airport deployment...\fAirports are where you'll deploy\ryour air units from.\fThe number next to the unit is how\rmuch it costs to deploy the unit.\fIf it is less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fUse the + Control Pad to select a\runit.\fYou can't use them on the same day\ryou deploy them, though.\f
Come back anytime you want\rto hear an explanation again!\f

Oh, port deployment...\fPorts are where you'll deploy\ryour sea units from.\fThe number next to the unit is how\rmuch it costs to deploy the unit.\fIf it is less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fUse the + Control Pad to select a\runit.\fYou can't use them on the same day\ryou deploy them, though.\f
Oh. Just ask me anytime you\rwant to hear it.\f
Thanks for listening!\fI hope I'll see you again soon.\f
